audit.whatIsWrong: Stored rows read Skill, Skill, Skill, Vladimir, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir. The early paragraph says 'Sett wins levels 1-2 hard', whys[0] and whys[1] both give those levels to Sett, and whys[3] calls 4-5 'skill-based and even' while the row says Vladimir.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Sett, Sett, Skill, Skill, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir) matches the prose on all seven rows; the stored rows disagree on three.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 1 become Sett; row 3 becomes Skill. Rows 2, 4, 5, 6 are already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sett's spikes are described without a single cooldown, and 'The Show Stopper' is written as 'Show Stopper' in spikes[3] and wants.you[2].
audit.why: Knuckle Down is 9s at rank 1 down to 5s; Haymaker 18s down to 12s; Facebreaker 16s down to 10s; The Show Stopper 120/100/80s at 400 range. Sanguine Pool at 28s rank 1 is slower than every one of his buttons at rank 1, which is exactly why the early levels are his.
audit.corrected: Haymaker at 18s rank 1 is the punish window; his level-6 grab is 120s and is the only thing the pool must be saved for.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions are absent. (1) Haymaker's centre deals TRUE damage — the page prescribes resistances and Sorcerer's Shoes without ever saying MR does not reduce it. (2) Facebreaker stuns only when enemies are on OPPOSITE sides of Sett; against a lone target it is a slow.
audit.why: Both change how the player positions. Stacking MR against a true-damage punch is the wrong answer, and standing so you are the only body on your side downgrades his stun to a slow.
audit.corrected: MR does not reduce Haymaker's centre — pool it instead. Stay on one side of Sett with no minions behind him and Facebreaker only slows. Vladimir is manaless, so trading costs him nothing but the health Tides of Blood charges.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — Shield + true damage. Pool it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Haymaker: 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — its centre is TRUE damage, so MR does not reduce it; pool the punch instead. - Facebreaker: 16s, and it only stuns with enemies on both sides of him. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Pool it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Grit shield plus true damage — MR will not save you, so pool the punch.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: Shield + true damage. Pool it. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only with enemies on both sides of him — alone, you are just slowed.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Haymaker's centre is true damage — armour and MR do not reduce it.

edits.before: Pooling to dodge poke — the pool is your KA answer and your only escape; spending it on chip is fatal.
edits.after: Facebreaker is 16s at rank 1 and only stuns with bodies on both sides — do not stand past his minions.

edits.before: Vladimir's Sanguine Pool dodges the Show Stopper (R) grab and your AoE percent-HP shred outlasts his bruiser sustain in fights.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetable dodges The Show Stopper (R) if you cast it before the grab lands, and your drain outlasts his sustain.

notes: MIRROR CONFLICT: the sett-side audit recorded the chart as Sett/Sett/Sett/Sett/Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir, giving Sett rows 2 and 3. The packet chart and this page's own prose (whys[2] 'You out-range his melee at 3, evening the lane'; whys[3] '4-5 skill-based and even') both say Skill for those rows, so I went with two agreeing sources over one. If the sett side is right, rows 2 and 3 need a second pass. Also unverified and left alone: spikes[3] and the late paragraph call Tides of Blood 'percent-HP shred' — no percentHealth flag on Vladimir's E and Riot's text does not say it. Whether Sanguine Pool can be cast while already suppressed by The Show Stopper is not answerable from the kit; my rewrite only claims the pool voids it when cast BEFORE the grab lands.
